new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fb1646b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mime/mime.go
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"io/fs"
+	standardmime "mime"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf"
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/log"
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+// LosslessFormats contains extension names without their leading periods.
+var LosslessFormats []string
+
+type configuration struct {
+	Types    map[string]string `yaml:"types"`
+	Lossless []string          `yaml:"lossless"`
+}
+
+func load(fsys fs.FS) error {
+	data, err := fs.ReadFile(fsys, "mime_types.yaml")
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("read mime_types.yaml: %w", err)
+	}
+	var config configuration
+	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("parse mime_types.yaml: %w", err)
+	}
+	if config.Types == nil || config.Lossless == nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("mime_types.yaml must define types and lossless")
+	}
+	for ext, typ := range config.Types {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(ext, ".") || typ == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid MIME type mapping %q: %q", ext, typ)
+		}
+	}
+	formats := make([]string, 0, len(config.Lossless))
+	for _, ext := range config.Lossless {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(ext, ".") || len(ext) == 1 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid lossless extension %q", ext)
+		}
+		formats = append(formats, strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
+	}
+
+	for ext, typ := range config.Types {
+		if err := standardmime.AddExtensionType(ext, typ); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("register MIME type for %q: %w", ext, err)
+		}
+	}
+	// Some Windows configurations associate JavaScript with text/plain.
+	if err := standardmime.AddExtensionType(".js", "text/javascript"); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := standardmime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css"); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	sort.Strings(formats)
+	LosslessFormats = formats
+	return nil
+}
+
+func init() {
+	conf.AddHook(func() {
+		if err := load(resources.FS()); err != nil {
+			log.Fatal("Unable to load MIME types", err)
+		}
+	})
+}

+++ b/mime/mime_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	standardmime "mime"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf"
+	"github.com/spf13/viper"
+)
+
+func TestLoadFromResourceOverrideOnStartup(t *testing.T) {
+	dataFolder := t.TempDir()
+	resourceFolder := filepath.Join(dataFolder, "resources")
+	if err := os.Mkdir(resourceFolder, 0755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	config := []byte("types:\n  .navidrometest: audio/x-navidrome-test\nlossless:\n  - .navidrometest\n")
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(resourceFolder, "mime_types.yaml"), config, 0644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	oldDataFolder := viper.GetString("datafolder")
+	oldServer := conf.Server
+	oldFormats := LosslessFormats
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		viper.Set("datafolder", oldDataFolder)
+		conf.Server = oldServer
+		LosslessFormats = oldFormats
+	})
+	viper.Set("datafolder", dataFolder)
+	conf.Load()
+
+	if got := standardmime.TypeByExtension(".navidrometest"); got != "audio/x-navidrome-test" {
+		t.Errorf("custom MIME type = %q", got)
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(LosslessFormats, []string{"navidrometest"}) {
+		t.Errorf("lossless formats = %v", LosslessFormats)
+	}
+	for ext, want := range map[string]string{".js": "text/javascript", ".css": "text/css"} {
+		got, _, err := standardmime.ParseMediaType(standardmime.TypeByExtension(ext))
+		if err != nil || got != want {
+			t.Errorf("MIME type for %s = %q, error = %v", ext, got, err)
+		}
+	}
+}
